CustomField.description: Optional time estimate in whole minutes shown as a chip on this page's stage card in Stages Mode (formTemplate.js renders `${value} min`). The stages overview also sums these across pages to compute the total time remaining shown at the top. Leave blank to omit the chip for this stage. Number(3,0) — enter 4 to display '4 min'. Queried onto Form_Submission_Stage__c via FormTemplate_Utility. No effect in the linear runtime.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter a whole number of minutes (e.g. 4) to show a time-estimate chip on this page's card in the Stages view. The overview also adds these up to show total time remaining; leave it blank to hide the chip for this stage.
CustomField.label: Estimated Time (Minutes)
